debug.ts.warning.title: Warning: duplicate or orphaned installation found:
debug.ts.desc.dup: Star Citizen exists more than once for this Star Citizen installation. The launcher only works on the active copy. You can inspect the others and delete them yourself.
debug.ts.desc.stale: The launcher would patch the wrong installation. "Set as active" writes the path you actually use into the settings.
debug.ts.desc.leftover: Empty Star Citizen folders on system drive C. That is where the RSI launcher installs by default – anyone who later moves to another drive leaves an empty shell behind. These leftovers confuse path detection and can be removed.
debug.ts.desc.orphan: Folders that look like Star Citizen but do not hold a complete installation. Usually leftovers from an old install. Not an error, just wasted space.
debug.ts.desc.active: Star Citizen currently uses these folders. That is where the launcher writes its files.
debug.ts.tt.nav.dup: The same Star Citizen installation sits in several folders. Only one of them is worked on.
debug.ts.tt.nav.stale: The settings point to a different folder than the one you actually play.
debug.ts.tt.nav.leftover: Empty Star Citizen folders on C:. Leftovers from the RSI launcher's default path.
debug.ts.tt.nav.orphan: Looks like Star Citizen, but is not a complete installation.
debug.ts.tt.nav.active: The folders the launcher currently writes to.
debug.ts.tt.paneHead.error: Needs cleaning up, otherwise the launcher may patch the wrong folder.
debug.ts.tt.paneHead.warn: Not an error, but probably wasted disk space.
debug.ts.tt.paneHead.ok: All good – just so you can see what applies.
debug.ts.tt.btn.openFolder: Opens the folder in Explorer. Nothing gets deleted.
debug.ts.tt.btn.setActive: Registers this folder as the active installation. The launcher patches there from now on.
debug.ts.tt.btn.start: Starts the checks. Read-only, nothing gets changed.
debug.ts.tt.btn.export: Packs log, screenshots and config excerpts into a ZIP file – handy for support.
debug.ts.tt.btn.github: Opens a pre-filled bug report on GitHub. You review the text and submit it yourself.
debug.ts.tt.btn.discord: No GitHub account? Get help on our Discord server.
debug.ts.tt.badge.checks: This many checks passed without anything unusual.
debug.ts.tt.badge.warnings: Oddities that do not stop the launcher from working.
debug.ts.tt.badge.errors: Findings worth a look – details in the list below.
debug.ts.tt.result.warn: Nothing broken, but leftovers from an old installation were found.
debug.ts.tt.result.error: The launcher might write to the wrong folder. See the list below.
debug.ts.intro.title: Run troubleshooting
debug.ts.intro.text: The troubleshooter checks your Star Citizen and launcher environment for common issues and collects everything into one report:
debug.ts.intro.point3: Duplicate or orphaned Star Citizen installations
debug.ts.intro.point4: Feature prerequisites per SC installation (language switch, log scan)
debug.ts.intro.note: Nothing gets changed, every check is read-only. A ZIP report is only created if you export it at the end.
debug.ts.run.title: Troubleshooting in progress…
debug.ts.busy.title: Already running
debug.ts.busy.text: A troubleshooting run is already in progress – please wait until it finishes.
debug.ts.done.title: Troubleshooting complete
debug.ts.done.result.ok: See results below and in problembehandlung-report.html in the ZIP file.
debug.ts.done.result.warn: Orphaned Star Citizen folders found, details below.
debug.ts.done.explain: This lists the problems found with your installation. Use "Open folder" to look at a path and clean it up yourself if you want. The launcher never deletes anything on its own.
debug.ts.btn.setActiveDone: Path corrected. Re-apply the changes in the main window. The old copy stays where it is, you will find its path the next time you run the analysis.
debug.ts.err.unknownPath: path not from the last scan
debug.ts.err.notScInstall: not a valid Star Citizen installation
debug.ts.err.channelMismatch: folder name does not match the expected SC installation
debug.ts.err.channelNotConfigured: no install path configured for this SC installation
debug.ts.done.exportHint: The full report (log, screenshots, config excerpts) can be exported as a ZIP, for example for support.
debug.ts.error.title: Troubleshooting failed
